assumptions.personnel: Illustrative loaded institutional hourly costs, including assumed employer charges; not a salary scale or recorded timesheet
assumptions.research_scope: Literature review, simulator, implementation, experiment operation, analysis, thesis and defense
assumptions.compute_scope: Budget allowances for model/service start-up, preprocessing, inference, plots, analysis and modest reruns; not measured GPU-hours
assumptions.vlm_limit: Recorded client request latency includes service/network overhead. No GPU type, server concurrency, token bill or resource accounting is available; it cannot establish actual GPU occupation or API expenditure. The 20-hour allowance and EUR 2/hour are a planning scenario, not a measured transfer of timings to another GPU.
assumptions.cnn_limit: Recorded train_seconds excludes parts of data loading, model construction, inference and Grad-CAM; no full job wall-clock accounting is available. The 10-hour allowance is assumed.

market_context.use: Order-of-magnitude context only; EUR 2 and EUR 1 are independent rounded budgeting assumptions, not foreign-exchange conversions or quotes. Rates and hardware differ from the recorded runs.

assumptions.workstation: EUR 1200 workstation / 48 months * 6 months = EUR 150; excludes a separately purchased GPU to avoid double counting rented compute
assumptions.cloud_energy: Included in assumed compute rates; not added again
assumptions.clinical_data: Existing supplied research data; no new ECG acquisition or prospective validation cost included
assumptions.excluded: Institutional overhead allocation, new clinical recruitment and labeling, prospective/multicentre validation, production deployment, foundation-model pretraining, indirect taxes where applicable
assumptions.tax_basis: Illustrative economic cost before applicable indirect taxes; do not add VAT to personnel
